description: This file defines the ForBlock class which extends Block and is part of the SCSSPHP library. It represents a control structure for SCSS loops, including properties for variable name, start and end values, and a flag indicating an 'until' loop.

classes.name: ForBlock
classes.description: Represents a for-loop block in SCSSCSS, extending the base Block class and including properties for loop variables and control flags.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a new ForBlock instance and sets its type to T_FOR.
